meanings.en: able to float or keep afloat
meanings.exampleEn: Cork is very buoyant, so it floats easily on water.
meanings.exampleTr: Mantar çok hafiftir ve suda kolayca yüzer.

meanings.en: cheerful and optimistic
meanings.exampleEn: She was in a buoyant mood after hearing the good news.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi haberi duyduktan sonra neşeli bir ruh halindeydi.

meanings.en: tending to rise or increase in level or activity
meanings.exampleEn: The economy remained buoyant despite global uncertainty.
meanings.exampleTr: Küresel belirsizliğe rağmen ekonomi canlı kaldı.

meanings.en: past participle of sink; gone below the surface of water
meanings.exampleEn: The ship had sunk before the rescue boats arrived.
meanings.exampleTr: Kurtarma botları gelmeden önce gemi batmıştı.

meanings.en: in serious trouble or ruined
meanings.exampleEn: If we lose this contract, we're sunk.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu sözleşmeyi kaybedersek, hapı yuttuk.

meanings.en: allowed by rules or law
meanings.exampleEn: It is not permissible to smoke inside the building.
meanings.exampleTr: Binanın içinde sigara içmeye izin verilmez.

meanings.en: in the middle of or surrounded by
meanings.exampleEn: The company announced layoffs amid growing financial pressure.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, artan mali baskı ortasında işten çıkarmaları duyurdu.

meanings.en: to attach or fasten something to another thing
meanings.exampleEn: Please affix a stamp to the top right corner of the envelope.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen zarfın sağ üst köşesine bir pul yapıştırın.

meanings.en: a letter or group of letters added to a word to change its meaning
meanings.exampleEn: The affix '-ness' turns an adjective into a noun.
meanings.exampleTr: '-lik' eki bir sıfatı isme dönüştürür.

meanings.en: the act of separating people, especially by race or gender
meanings.exampleEn: Racial segregation was outlawed in many countries during the twentieth century.
meanings.exampleTr: Irk ayrımı yirminci yüzyılda birçok ülkede yasaklandı.

meanings.en: the quality of being unusual or exceptional
meanings.exampleEn: The exceptionality of her talent set her apart from the other students.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeteneğinin olağanüstülüğü onu diğer öğrencilerden ayırıyordu.

meanings.en: wrong or not as it should be
meanings.exampleEn: She sensed that something was amiss the moment she walked in.
meanings.exampleTr: İçeri girdiği anda bir şeylerin ters gittiğini sezdi.

meanings.en: the inability to produce offspring or crops
meanings.exampleEn: The couple sought medical help for their infertility.
meanings.exampleTr: Çift, kısırlıkları için tıbbi yardım aradı.

meanings.en: in a way that is fair, just, or according to law
meanings.exampleEn: The land was rightfully returned to its original owners.
meanings.exampleTr: Toprak, asıl sahiplerine haklı olarak geri verildi.

meanings.en: to find a way around a rule, problem, or obstacle
meanings.exampleEn: They found a loophole to circumvent the new regulations.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni düzenlemeleri atlatmak için bir açık buldular.

meanings.en: using flattery or coaxing to persuade someone
meanings.exampleEn: In a wheedling voice, the child begged for more candy.
meanings.exampleTr: Yağcı bir sesle, çocuk daha fazla şeker için yalvardı.

meanings.en: the official cancellation of something, especially a marriage
meanings.exampleEn: She sought an annulment of the marriage after just three months.
meanings.exampleTr: Sadece üç ay sonra evliliğin iptalini talep etti.

meanings.en: a metal or plastic container for holding liquids or gases
meanings.exampleEn: The firefighters carried a cannister of foam to put out the fire.
meanings.exampleTr: İtfaiyeciler yangını söndürmek için bir köpük kanisteri taşıdı.

meanings.en: a sheet of canvas or plastic stretched over a frame for shelter
meanings.exampleEn: We sat under the café's striped awning to escape the sun.
meanings.exampleTr: Güneşten kaçmak için kafenin çizgili tentesinin altına oturduk.

meanings.en: to run with long, relaxed strides
meanings.exampleEn: The wolf began to lope across the open field.
meanings.exampleTr: Kurt açık arazide uzun adımlarla koşmaya başladı.

meanings.en: changing frequently, especially in loyalties or affections
meanings.exampleEn: The fickle public quickly lost interest in the new star.
meanings.exampleTr: Kararsız halk yeni yıldıza olan ilgisini çabucak kaybetti.

meanings.en: a person who looks after a child, sick, or elderly person
meanings.exampleEn: As the primary caregiver, she looked after her elderly mother every day.
meanings.exampleTr: Birincil bakıcı olarak, her gün yaşlı annesine baktı.

meanings.en: to touch or stroke gently and lovingly
meanings.exampleEn: She began to fondle the puppy's soft ears.
meanings.exampleTr: Köpeğin yumuşak kulaklarını okşamaya başladı.

meanings.en: a closed box for saving coins
meanings.exampleEn: The little boy dropped his pocket money into his moneybox.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük çocuk harçlığını kumbarasına attı.

meanings.en: past tense of grab; took hold of something suddenly
meanings.exampleEn: He grabbed his coat and rushed out of the door.
meanings.exampleTr: Ceketini kaptı ve kapıdan dışarı fırladı.

meanings.en: the activity of fighting a war
meanings.exampleEn: Modern warfare relies heavily on advanced technology.
meanings.exampleTr: Modern savaş büyük ölçüde ileri teknolojiye dayanır.

meanings.tr: aralıksız, durmadan devam eden, bitmek bilmeyen
meanings.en: continuing without pause or interruption
meanings.exampleEn: The incessant noise from the construction site gave her a headache.
meanings.exampleTr: İnşaat alanından gelen aralıksız gürültü başını ağrıttı.

meanings.en: the central and most important part of an activity or place
meanings.exampleEn: The city has become a major hub for international trade.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehir, uluslararası ticaret için önemli bir merkez haline geldi.

meanings.en: the central part of a wheel
meanings.exampleEn: The spokes connect the rim of the wheel to the hub.
meanings.exampleTr: Teller, tekerleğin jantını göbeğe bağlar.

meanings.tr: yeniden başlama, kaldığı yerden devam etme
meanings.en: the act of starting something again after a pause
meanings.exampleEn: Both sides welcomed the resumption of peace talks.
meanings.exampleTr: Her iki taraf da barış görüşmelerinin yeniden başlamasını memnuniyetle karşıladı.

meanings.en: a person who is very unwilling to spend money
meanings.exampleEn: He's such a tightwad that he never buys anyone a drink.
meanings.exampleTr: O kadar cimri ki kimseye içki ısmarlamaz.

meanings.tr: doğrulayıcı, teyit eden kişi veya sistem
meanings.en: a person or thing that checks the truth or accuracy of something
meanings.exampleEn: The system uses an automated verifier to confirm each transaction.
meanings.exampleTr: Sistem, her işlemi onaylamak için otomatik bir doğrulayıcı kullanır.

meanings.en: the job of looking after children while their parents are at work
meanings.exampleEn: She earns extra income from childminding during the week.
meanings.exampleTr: Hafta içi çocuk bakıcılığından ek gelir kazanıyor.

meanings.en: short and rather fat
meanings.exampleEn: The tubby little man could barely fit through the door.
meanings.exampleTr: Tombul, ufak tefek adam kapıdan zar zor geçebildi.

meanings.en: round and plump, especially in a person's body
meanings.exampleEn: The rotund chef laughed heartily as he stirred the pot.
meanings.exampleTr: Tıknaz aşçı tencereyi karıştırırken içten içe güldü.

meanings.en: something that is very easy to do (British informal)
meanings.exampleEn: Once you know the trick, the exam is a doddle.
meanings.exampleTr: Numarayı öğrendikten sonra sınav çocuk oyuncağı.

meanings.en: a person or thing that breaks something
meanings.exampleEn: He earned a reputation as a rule breaker at school.
meanings.exampleTr: Okulda kural bozan biri olarak ün kazandı.

meanings.en: a large wave that breaks on the shore
meanings.exampleEn: The surfers waited for the next big breaker to roll in.
meanings.exampleTr: Sörfçüler bir sonraki büyük dalganın gelmesini bekledi.

meanings.en: a switch that stops the flow of electricity when needed
meanings.exampleEn: The circuit breaker tripped when the wire overheated.
meanings.exampleTr: Kablo aşırı ısınınca devre kesici attı.

meanings.en: a strong building used for military defense
meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers defended the fort against the enemy attack.
meanings.exampleTr: Askerler kaleyi düşman saldırısına karşı savundu.

meanings.en: a loud, unpleasant, and continuous noise
meanings.exampleEn: We could barely hear each other over the din of the crowd.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalabalığın gürültüsünde birbirimizi zar zor duyabiliyorduk.

meanings.en: in a secret way, so that others do not notice
meanings.exampleEn: He surreptitiously glanced at his phone during the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantı sırasında gizlice telefonuna göz attı.

meanings.tr: çınlama, madeni tok ses (metal çarpma sesi)
meanings.en: a loud, ringing sound made by metal being struck
meanings.exampleEn: The gate shut with a loud clang.
meanings.exampleTr: Kapı yüksek bir çınlamayla kapandı.

meanings.en: to make a loud ringing metallic sound
meanings.exampleEn: The bells clanged loudly across the town.
meanings.exampleTr: Çanlar tüm kasabada yüksek sesle çınladı.

meanings.en: a remark that has been used so often it is dull and meaningless
meanings.exampleEn: The speech was full of empty platitudes about hard work and success.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşma, çalışkanlık ve başarı hakkında boş klişelerle doluydu.

meanings.en: the quality of being boring, ordinary, or unoriginal
meanings.exampleEn: The film's dialogue was criticized for its banality.
meanings.exampleTr: Filmin diyalogları sıradanlığı nedeniyle eleştirildi.

meanings.en: rudely brief in speech or manner
meanings.exampleEn: Her curt reply made it clear she was annoyed.
meanings.exampleTr: Sert ve kısa cevabı, sinirlendiğini açıkça belli etti.

meanings.tr: kısa ve öz, az sözlü, keskin
meanings.en: using few words, sometimes in a way that seems rude
meanings.exampleEn: He gave a terse response and refused to explain further.
meanings.exampleTr: Kısa ve öz bir cevap verdi ve daha fazla açıklama yapmayı reddetti.

meanings.en: lasting longer than necessary or expected
meanings.exampleEn: The negotiations turned into a long, drawn-out process.
meanings.exampleTr: Müzakereler uzun, sürüncemede bir sürece dönüştü.

meanings.en: the state of being unclear, misty, or vague
meanings.exampleEn: The haziness of the morning air made the mountains hard to see.
meanings.exampleTr: Sabah havasının puslu olması dağları görmeyi zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: lack of clarity in thought or memory
meanings.exampleEn: There was a certain haziness about the details of that night.
meanings.exampleTr: O gecenin ayrıntıları konusunda belli bir muğlaklık vardı.

meanings.en: well informed about something (British informal)
meanings.exampleEn: She's really clued-up about the latest technology.
meanings.exampleTr: En yeni teknoloji konusunda gerçekten bilgili.

meanings.en: a bunch of hair, grass, or threads growing or held together
meanings.exampleEn: A tuft of grass grew between the paving stones.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaldırım taşlarının arasında bir tutam ot bitmişti.

meanings.en: to make or become rough in texture
meanings.exampleEn: Years of manual labor had roughened his hands.
meanings.exampleTr: Yılların el emeği ellerini pürüzlendirmişti.
